notes: Descriptors are synchronous zeroed stack records; Native copies/pins/retains remain real costs
Browser/image APIs are declaration/ABI only, no external I/O execution
Supported NULL branches use exact same-symbol physical aliases; Renderer active-position and View ordinary selection reject NULL and have no invented clear method
